ledger: Foreground Woman | Standing, facing mirror, large tattoo on left arm | Raises and lowers right arm | Feet remain planted on the floor
Reflection Woman | Standing, facing camera, large tattoo on right arm (correctly mirrored) | Raises and lowers left arm | Feet remain planted on the floor

findings.description: The foreground woman raises her right arm, but her reflection raises its left arm. A true mirror reflection would show the right arm (the one directly opposite the physical arm) moving.
